post.summary: CreateBlock creates a new block in a staff member's schedule.
post.description:
Returns:
- The newly created Block object
- INVALID_ARGUMENT if the request is malformed
- PERMISSION_DENIED if the caller lacks permission
- NOT_FOUND if the business_id or staff_id is invalid

parameters.name: body
parameters.description:
CreateBlockRequest contains the information needed to create a new block
in a staff member's schedule.

get.summary: GetBlock retrieves a specific block by its ID.
get.description:
Returns:
- The requested Block object
- NOT_FOUND if the block doesn't exist
- PERMISSION_DENIED if the caller lacks permission

parameters.name: id
parameters.description:
Unique identifier of the block to retrieve.
Must be a valid block ID that exists in the system.

startTime.description:
Optional. Inclusive start of the interval.

If specified, a Timestamp matching this interval will have to be the same
or after the start.

endTime.description:
Optional. Exclusive end of the interval.

If specified, a Timestamp matching this interval will have to be before the
end.

typeInterval.description:
Represents a time interval, encoded as a Timestamp start (inclusive) and a
Timestamp end (exclusive).

The start must be less than or equal to the end.
When the start equals the end, the interval is empty (matches no time).
When both start and end are unspecified, the interval matches any time.

staffId.description: ID of the staff member whose schedule is being blocked.

duration.description:
The time interval during which the staff member is unavailable.
Uses Google's standard Interval type to represent the start and end times.

description.description: Optional description of why the time is blocked off (e.g., "Lunch break", "Team meeting").

colorCode.description:
Color code used to visually distinguish this block in the calendar UI.
Should be a valid hex color code (e.g., "#FF0000" for red).

businessId.description:
ID of the business where this block is created.
Used for access control and filtering blocks by business.

v1Block.description:
Block represents a time period that is blocked off in a staff member's schedule.
This can be used for breaks, meetings, or any other time when the staff member
is not available for appointments.

businessId.description:
ID of the business where the block will be created.
Required for access control and proper block organization.

staffId.description:
ID of the staff member whose schedule will be blocked.
Must be a valid staff member ID within the specified business.

duration.description:
The time interval during which the staff member will be unavailable.
Must be a valid time interval with both start and end times specified.

description.title:
Optional description explaining why the time is being blocked off.
Examples: "Lunch break", "Team meeting", "Training session"

colorCode.description:
Optional color code for visual distinction in the calendar UI.
Should be a valid hex color code (e.g., "#FF0000" for red).

v1CreateBlockRequest.description:
CreateBlockRequest contains the information needed to create a new block
in a staff member's schedule.
